<!-- @slot perceivable-rows -->
| C-FS-01 | Amounts, currencies and account identifiers are exposed as text that assistive technology reads correctly, including the sign and the currency (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1). | [ ] | |
| C-FS-02 | A masked account number is announced as masked, and is not read as a run of symbols (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.1.1). | [ ] | |

<!-- @slot operable-rows -->
| C-FS-03 | The user is warned before an authenticated session times out, without losing entered payment data; where the regulatory inactivity limit prevents an extension, that is recorded (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.2.1; RTS (EU) 2018/389 Art. 4). | [ ] | |
| C-FS-04 | The strong customer authentication challenge works with the keyboard alone and with a screen reader (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1). | [ ] | |

<!-- @slot understandable-rows -->
| C-FS-05 | Before a payment is submitted, the user can review, correct and confirm the amount and the payee (WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.4; RTS (EU) 2018/389 Art. 5). | [ ] | |
| C-FS-06 | Authentication does not rely on a cognitive function test alone; an alternative method or a supported aid such as paste or a password manager is available (WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.8). | [ ] | |
| C-FS-07 | A declined or failed payment states in text what happened, whether money moved and what the user can do next (WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.1, 3.3.3). | [ ] | |

<!-- @slot robust-rows -->
| C-FS-08 | Payment status changes (pending, authorised, failed) are announced without moving focus (WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.3). | [ ] | |
| C-FS-09 | An embedded or redirected third-party payment or authentication step is included in the accessibility test, or its provider's conformance statement is on file. | [ ] | |
